blocks.label: Practice
blocks.instructions:
Directional Inference — PracticeEnemy drones are approaching from either the EAST or WEST.
  • Each contact you observe costs 5 pts. Correct decision: +100 pts. Wrong: -500 pts.
  • Click WAIT to observe the next contact on the bearing strip. Click EAST or WEST when confident.
  • You may observe up to 20 contacts before you must decide.

blocks.label: Main Task
blocks.instructions: Directional InferenceEach contact observed costs 5 pts. Correct: +100 pts. Wrong: -500 pts. Decide EAST or WEST when confident — up to 20 contacts per round.
